## 1. Create a Dataset

```{python}
#| label: generate-data
#| cache: true
import polars as pl
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

X, y = make_classification(n_samples=2000, n_features=20, n_informative=10, random_state=42)
df = pl.DataFrame({f"feat_{i}": X[:, i] for i in range(X.shape[1])})
df = df.with_columns(target=pl.Series(y))
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}  |  Positive class: {df['target'].mean():.1%}")
```

## 2. Run an Experiment

```{python}
#| label: run-experiment
#| cache: true
from iter8ml import ExperimentSession, ExperimentConfig, TaskType

session = ExperimentSession()
config = ExperimentConfig(
    name="quickstart",
    task=TaskType.CLASSIFICATION,
    target_col="target",
    data_path="",
    models=["catboost", "lightgbm"],
    cv_folds=3,
)

results = session.run(config, df)
```

## 3. Inspect the Leaderboard

```{python}
#| label: leaderboard
lb = session.leaderboard()
print(lb)
```

## 4. Export the Champion

```{python}
#| label: export
#| error: true
path = session.export("quickstart:classification")
print(f"Exported to: {path}")
```
